Last release: @thoth-agents/pi-thoth-theme@0.6.3
Target ref: @thoth-agents/pi-thoth-theme@0.7.0

## Core
### Improvements

- `6253cc5` feat(pi-packages): add selectable animation intensity
- `10b5653` perf(pi-packages): keep the TUI responsive while subagents run

Last release: @thoth-agents/pi-subagents@0.9.0
Target ref: @thoth-agents/pi-subagents@0.10.0

## Core
### Improvements

- `4592e02` perf(pi-subagents): persist history only at turn and tool boundaries
- `6253cc5` feat(pi-packages): add selectable animation intensity
- `30e052f` perf(pi-subagents): index retention candidates instead of scanning history
- `8fe80e1` perf(pi-subagents): run history pruning only while no subagent is active
- `d0f2d6f` perf(pi-packages): drop redundant renders and per-event debug config reads
- `6f0c33f` perf(pi-subagents): skip openai-fast startup in physical-model children
- `10b5653` perf(pi-packages): keep the TUI responsive while subagents run

## Docs & CI
### Improvements

- `3f0522c` feat(pi-subagents): edit manual tool entries in /subagents-tools
